from AlgorithmImports import *


class TwoStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma_200 = self.SMA(self.spy, 200, Resolution.Daily)
        self.spy_sma_50 = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.SetWarmUp(200, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if self.spy in data.Bars else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if self.aapl in data.Bars else None

        previous_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
        previous_spy_sma_200 = self.previous_spy_sma_200
        previous_spy_sma_50 = self.previous_spy_sma_50

        if spy_bar is not None:
            if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady:
                current_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
            else:
                current_spy_sma_200 = None

            if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady:
                current_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
            else:
                current_spy_sma_50 = None

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close

            if current_spy_sma_200 is not None:
                self.previous_spy_sma_200 = current_spy_sma_200

            if current_spy_sma_50 is not None:
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 = current_spy_sma_50

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        required_symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in required_symbols):
            return

        if not (
            self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
            and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
            and previous_spy_close is not None
            and previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
            and previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
        ):
            return

        spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        current_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
        current_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
        current_aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value

        strategy_a_sell = (
            self.strategy_a_lot > 0
            and previous_spy_close >= previous_spy_sma_50
            and spy_close < current_spy_sma_50
        )

        if strategy_a_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0:
            strategy_a_buy = (
                previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma_200
                and spy_close > current_spy_sma_200
            )

            if strategy_a_buy:
                quantity = int(
                    0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy_close
                )

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        strategy_b_sell = (
            self.strategy_b_lot > 0
            and current_aapl_rsi > 60
        )

        if strategy_b_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            available_cash = self.Portfolio.Cash
            if available_cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_bar.Close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class ExactStrategy(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.required_symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma_200 = self.SMA(self.spy, 200, Resolution.Daily)
        self.spy_sma_50 = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(200, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.strategy_a_buy_pending = False
        self.strategy_a_sell_pending = False
        self.strategy_b_buy_pending = False
        self.strategy_b_sell_pending = False

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.order_labels = {}

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if self.spy in data.Bars else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if self.aapl in data.Bars else None

        current_spy_close = None
        current_spy_sma_200 = None
        current_spy_sma_50 = None

        if spy_bar is not None:
            current_spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)

            if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady:
                current_spy_sma_200 = float(self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value)

            if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady:
                current_spy_sma_50 = float(self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value)

        current_aapl_close = None
        current_aapl_rsi = None

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            current_aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif current_aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            if self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady:
                current_aapl_rsi = float(self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value)

        if not self.IsWarmingUp:
            all_bars_present = all(
                symbol in data.Bars for symbol in self.required_symbols
            )

            if all_bars_present:
                strategy_a_sell = (
                    self.strategy_a_lot > 0
                    and not self.strategy_a_sell_pending
                    and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                    and self.previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
                    and current_spy_close is not None
                    and current_spy_sma_50 is not None
                    and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma_50
                    and current_spy_close < current_spy_sma_50
                )

                strategy_b_sell = (
                    self.strategy_b_lot > 0
                    and not self.strategy_b_sell_pending
                    and current_aapl_rsi is not None
                    and current_aapl_rsi > 60
                )

                if strategy_a_sell:
                    self.strategy_a_sell_pending = True
                    ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                        self.spy,
                        -self.strategy_a_lot,
                        tag="STRATEGY_A_SELL"
                    )
                    if ticket is not None:
                        self.order_labels[ticket.OrderId] = "STRATEGY_A_SELL"
                    else:
                        self.strategy_a_sell_pending = False

                if strategy_b_sell:
                    self.strategy_b_sell_pending = True
                    ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                        self.aapl,
                        -self.strategy_b_lot,
                        tag="STRATEGY_B_SELL"
                    )
                    if ticket is not None:
                        self.order_labels[ticket.OrderId] = "STRATEGY_B_SELL"
                    else:
                        self.strategy_b_sell_pending = False

                strategy_a_buy = (
                    self.strategy_a_lot == 0
                    and not self.strategy_a_buy_pending
                    and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                    and self.previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
                    and current_spy_close is not None
                    and current_spy_sma_200 is not None
                    and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
                    and current_spy_close > current_spy_sma_200
                )

                strategy_b_buy = (
                    self.strategy_b_lot == 0
                    and not self.strategy_b_buy_pending
                    and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                    and current_aapl_close is not None
                    and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000
                )

                if strategy_a_buy:
                    target_value = 0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
                    quantity = math.floor(target_value / current_spy_close)

                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.strategy_a_buy_pending = True
                        ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                            self.spy,
                            quantity,
                            tag="STRATEGY_A_BUY"
                        )
                        if ticket is not None:
                            self.order_labels[ticket.OrderId] = "STRATEGY_A_BUY"
                        else:
                            self.strategy_a_buy_pending = False

                if strategy_b_buy:
                    quantity = math.floor(20000 / current_aapl_close)

                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.strategy_b_buy_pending = True
                        ticket = self.MarketOrder(
                            self.aapl,
                            quantity,
                            tag="STRATEGY_B_BUY"
                        )
                        if ticket is not None:
                            self.order_labels[ticket.OrderId] = "STRATEGY_B_BUY"
                        else:
                            self.strategy_b_buy_pending = False

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma_200 = current_spy_sma_200
            self.previous_spy_sma_50 = current_spy_sma_50
        else:
            self.previous_spy_close = None
            self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
            self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_close = current_aapl_close
        else:
            self.previous_aapl_close = None
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        label = self.order_labels.get(order_event.OrderId)

        if label == "STRATEGY_A_BUY":
            self.strategy_a_lot += int(order_event.FillQuantity)
            if order_event.Status in (
                OrderStatus.Filled,
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid
            ):
                self.strategy_a_buy_pending = False

        elif label == "STRATEGY_A_SELL":
            self.strategy_a_lot = max(
                0,
                self.strategy_a_lot + int(order_event.FillQuantity)
            )
            if order_event.Status in (
                OrderStatus.Filled,
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid
            ):
                self.strategy_a_sell_pending = False

        elif label == "STRATEGY_B_BUY":
            self.strategy_b_lot += int(order_event.FillQuantity)
            if order_event.Status in (
                OrderStatus.Filled,
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid
            ):
                self.strategy_b_buy_pending = False

        elif label == "STRATEGY_B_SELL":
            self.strategy_b_lot = max(
                0,
                self.strategy_b_lot + int(order_event.FillQuantity)
            )
            if order_event.Status in (
                OrderStatus.Filled,
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid
            ):
                self.strategy_b_sell_pending = False
